manager.name: Task Manager
manager.description: Central task orchestrator that routes work requests to specialized agents

agent-builder.name: Builder Agent
agent-builder.description: Handles feature implementation, refactoring, testing, and documentation work

file-sorter-agent.name: File Sorter Agent
file-sorter-agent.description: Organizes files by type, date, or size; groups content and creates workspace reports

code-errors-agent.name: Code Errors Agent
code-errors-agent.description: Analyzes stack traces, runtime exceptions, failing tests, and code snippets to diagnose root causes and suggest fixes

code_quality.name: Code Quality & Refactoring
code_quality.description: Improving code quality, refactoring, and optimization

task_template.goal: Refactor code for clarity and performance

bug_fix.name: Bug Fixes
bug_fix.description: Fixing bugs and issues in existing code

file_organization.name: File Organization & Cleanup
file_organization.description: Sorting, grouping, and organizing files into sensible structures

task_template.goal: Organize files in the target directory
requirements: Group by type, date, or size

debugging.name: Debugging & Error Resolution
debugging.description: Investigating stack traces, exceptions, and failing runtime behavior

task_template.goal: Diagnose and fix the reported code issue
requirements: Collect the error message or stack trace
Verify with available tests or reproduction

testing.name: Testing & QA
testing.description: Adding tests, improving test coverage, and QA

code_review.name: Code Review & Audit
code_review.description: Reviewing code quality, security, and best practices

task_template.goal: Audit code for quality and best practices

priority_keywords.pattern: sort files|organize files|group files|clean workspace|find large files|move files

steps.name: User Input
steps.description: User provides task description to the manager

steps.name: Task Classification
steps.description: Manager analyzes task and determines category based on keywords and context

steps.name: Agent Assignment
steps.description: Manager routes task to the appropriate agent based on classification

steps.name: Task Execution
steps.description: Assigned agent executes task with specified requirements and depth

steps.name: Results & Artifacts
steps.description: Agent returns results, patches, and artifacts for review

steps.name: User Review
steps.description: User reviews artifacts and decides on approval/rejection

feature_request.user_prompt: I need to implement a new user authentication module with login and signup endpoints

structured_task.goal: Implement user authentication module with login and signup endpoints
requirements: Include unit tests for all endpoints

bug_fix_request.user_prompt: There's a bug where users can't reset their password. The reset email never gets sent.

structured_task.goal: Fix password reset email delivery issue
requirements: Reproduce the bug with test case

debugging_request.user_prompt: The app crashes with a TypeError in the login flow after the user submits the form. We need the stack trace analyzed and fixed.

structured_task.goal: Diagnose and fix the login TypeError in the user submission flow
requirements: Review the stack trace and error message
Identify the null or wrong-type value causing the crash
Verify with the app or failing test

file_sort_request.user_prompt: Please sort the project files into sensible folders and group them by type so the workspace is easier to navigate.

structured_task.goal: Organize the workspace into a sensible folder structure by file type

refactoring_request.user_prompt: The database module has a lot of duplicate connection handling code. Let's refactor it for DRY principles.

structured_task.goal: Refactor database module to eliminate duplication
requirements: Extract common patterns into shared functions
Add unit tests for refactored code
Run full test suite to verify no regressions

test_coverage_request.user_prompt: The payment processing module needs better test coverage. Add tests for edge cases and error scenarios.

structured_task.goal: Improve test coverage for payment processing module
requirements: Add tests for all payment methods
Test edge cases (invalid amounts, timeout scenarios)
Test error conditions (payment failures, network issues)

code_review_request.user_prompt: Can you audit the API handler code for security issues and best practices before we merge the feature branch?

structured_task.goal: Security and best practices audit of API handler code

critical.description: Breaks production, security vulnerability, data loss risk

high.description: Significant impact on functionality or user experience

manager_decision_logic.input_analysis: Manager reads user prompt and extracts key information: what needs to be done, where, and why
manager_decision_logic.category_matching: Manager matches keywords against priority_keywords in routing_rules to determine task category
manager_decision_logic.agent_selection: Manager selects appropriate agent based on task_classification
manager_decision_logic.task_structuring: Manager structures unstructured user input into formal task JSON with goal, targets, requirements
manager_decision_logic.execution: Manager invokes selected agent with structured task
manager_decision_logic.output_handling: Manager collects agent output (status, plan, artifacts) and presents to user for review

manager_to_user: I've received your request. Let me analyze and route this appropriately...
